articles.title: Indonesia seeks to diversify network routes, reduce 90 per cent internet connectivity dependence on Singapore
articles.summary: Indonesia is diversifying its international connectivity, prompted by concerns over dependence on Singapore. Observers warn of risks from natural disasters and accidents potentially disrupting crucial links. This strategic move aims to enhance Indonesia's resilience and secure its global connections, minimizing vulnerabilities posed by over-reliance on a single hub, thereby ensuring more robust and stable international engagement.

articles.title: Centre likely to extend ₹500-crore loan support to Pawan Hans
articles.summary: State-owned helicopter operator Pawan Hans Ltd (PHL) is anticipated to secure an approximately 500-crore Centre-backed loan with a 10-year tenure. This significant financial support, currently under government examination, is crucial for bolstering the operational capabilities and financial stability of the national helicopter service provider, ensuring its continued role in India's aviation sector.
